name: Flight phase and extremes are kept by the session, not by the dashboard
step: Check the session flight phase and extremes
rationale:
Issue #2344: the flight phase and the flight extremes lived in the dashboard widget, so with the dashboard closed nothing was tracked. lib/flight_stats.lua holds the same phase rules and the same recording, and the session drives it every tick; the dashboard and the ActiveLook widget read the result from the session snapshot.

The harness feeds the module a session-shaped table through a flight, a link loss and a reconnect, a second flight, a craft change, the governor counting as flight, and checks the recorded min, max, average and headspeed variance. Against master the module does not exist, so the harness fails.
